description: The insects of the first map (map0_s00, the alley): flies over the carcass and three groups of crawlers on the ground that scatter when Harry comes near. Distances in metres (stored as Q12 the way the original's float constants converted), up is negative. The keys starting with '_' explain the key of the same name. Every key is checked. A mod replaces the whole file with its own copy at the same path.
_anchors: [0] the carcass the flies hover over; [1..3] the centre of each crawler group
_activate_within: the insects run only while Harry is closer than this (manhattan) to anchor 0 or 1

flies._spread: a fly starts within +-spread of the carcass sideways and up to `height` above it
flies._dart_chance: a fly darts at Harry's hand (or back to the carcass) when a random number below this is 64
flies._sheet: cells of the sprite sheet, one picture each, cycled every cell_frames; sprites above min_slot of the ordering table are drawn

crawlers._startle_radius: a crawler closer to Harry than this flees

look._size: a sprite is `max` pixels wide close by, one less per depth step, `min` from far_steps on. The original stops at 3 pixels (far_steps 13), which at a high resolution draws every distant fly as a 3x3 blob of its whole picture; 1 keeps them specks
look._darkness_cap: a fly is lit by the darkness at its place, at most this
look._modes: light modes where the flashlight adds the darkness in full, and where a fly keeps the plain light colour; any other mode adds an eighth
